text:
Sam K: quick mid-q check — runtime-v3 milestone status? what shipped, what slipped, owners, blockers?
Julia P: shipped: autoscale tuning landed yesterday (runtime team). Verified with loadtest, looks within SLOs.
Kevin L: slipped: canary rollout for dedupe-cache feature. blocked by a failing e2e that repros only under high ctx length.
Sam K: @Kevin L can you share failing test/logs? short stacktrace is fine.
Kevin L: pasted snippet: `ERROR kv_cache: index out of range at kv_cache::read(0x7f...)` — reproduced locally with seq_len=4096 + concurrent requests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 (WIP)
Tanvi R: I'll take ownership of the canary rollout once the PR is green. My plan: disable dedupe for 1% canary -> monitor.
Leo M: infra note: blocked by GPU node image mismatch — baked image for canary doesn't contain the new kernel. I'm on it, ETA ~2hrs.
Julia P: sounds good. if infra fixes in 2hrs, canary disable plan + rollout same day.
Sam K: owners/deps summary for doc: autoscale tuning (Julia) — shipped, close OKR. dedupe-cache canary (Kevin -> Tanvi takeover) — slipped -> dependant on infra (Leo). next step: infra image fix, PR stabilization, then Tanvi triggers canary.
Kevin L: FYI added unit test to catch index issue. might need a small refactor.
Tanvi R: CR ping @Kevin L — can you mark ready for review? I'll do quick pass once green.
Kevin L: marked ready. also adding checklist in PR description with rollback criteria and metrics to watch (latency p99, error rate).
infra-bot: Deploy pipeline failed for `canary-image-v3` — build log: `bazel test //deploy:canary_image` exited 1.
Leo M: looking at build logs now, found missing dependency in Dockerfile. patching.
Sam K: thanks all. I'll update the OKR tracker after rollout or tomorrow morning if we don't get canary out today. If anyone thinks we should change priorities, call it out here.
Julia P: small ask — please add the user-impact note in OKR comment (what customers see if we keep dedupe off during canary). helps PMs decide canary size.
Sam K: good call, Julia. Kevin/Tanvi add that to PR and I'll mirror into OKR thread.
Tanvi R: will do.
Kevin L: added note + link to test harness.
Sam K: ack. :thumbsup:
Julia P: :rocket:
